newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 10.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Thursday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Financially ailing Nippon Credit Bank Ltd to tie up with Bankers Trust New York Corp.
-- Fair Trade Commission (FTC) approves merger of Mitsui Petrochemical Industries Ltd and Mitsui Toatsu Chemicals Inc.
-- Power Reactor and Nuclear Fuel Development Corporation (PNC) to penalise people involved in cover-up at Tokaimura nuclear fuel reprocessing plant in Ibaraki prefecture.
-- Nago mayor gives go-ahead for feasibility study on U.S. military heliport in Okinawa.
-- Science and Technology Agency to set up study panel on reform of Power Reactor and Nuclear Fuel Development Corporation.
-- Finance Ministry predicts Nippon Credit Bank will have additional 470 billion yen loss.
-- Sixty-one percent of Okinawa residents opposed to proposed revision of law for compulsory land leasing for U.S. military.
-- Posts and Telecommunications ministry eyes legislation to protect electronics transactions.
